name: WARRIORS
description: WARRIORS is a large-scale dataset of web search user behaviors in both Chinese and English, developed to support research in information retrieval and user simulation. It is part of the BASES framework, which uses LLM-based agents to simulate diverse and large-scale human-like web search behaviors.
reputation: A niche but recognized benchmark within search behavior simulation research, especially as part of the BASES framework, though it has not yet seen broad community adoption.
notes: Dataset supports large-scale user simulation for web search; complements BASES simulation framework; includes bilingual data.
